title: Return two values in an array
prompt: A function can only return one thing, so return an array holding two: a plus b, then a minus b.
signature: func solve(a: int, b: int) -> Array:
starter:
func solve(a: int, b: int) -> Array:
	return []
hint: Calculations can go straight inside the square brackets.
solution:
func solve(a: int, b: int) -> Array:
	return [a + b, a - b]
